item.title: Attorney General Ellison leads coalition urging Supreme Court to grant review to protect key provision of Voting Rights Act
item.description:
Publication Date: October 06, 2025

Coalition of 23 AGs asks court to review decision that overturns 60-year history of private citizens being able to sue for voting-rights violations
